record.issue_text: packages/core/EventManager.ts:344 — Credential (incl. OAuth key) loaded from DB by destinationCalendar.credentialId with no check that it belongs to a booking host/team member or is not invalid, bypassing the calendarCredentials allowlist.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents` (around the added loop starting ~332), when a `destination.credentialId` is present but not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, the code fetches that credential directly from the DB (`prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } })`) and then uses it to call `createEvent(...)`. There is no verification that the fetched credential belongs to an allowed host/team member for the booking/event, and no check that `credentialFromDB.invalid` is false before using it (it is copied into the object but not enforced). This bypasses the prior allowlist behavior of only using `this.calendarCredentials` and can lead to using unauthorized/invalid OAuth credentials if an unexpected `destinationCalendar.credentialId` is present.
